h1: Homes for Sale in Southwest Sioux Falls
lead: Newer subdivisions and established neighborhoods west of Minnesota Avenue and south of 26th Street, close to I-29.
living:
Southwest Sioux Falls covers the part of the city west of Minnesota Avenue and south of about 26th Street. It includes the busy shopping area around 41st Street and Louise Avenue, home of the Empire Mall, and a lot of the city's growth in the last 20 years.

Closer to 41st Street you'll find homes from the 1970s–90s. South of 57th Street and out toward Tea, most homes are newer subdivisions with modern layouts.
know: What to know before you buy in Southwest Sioux Falls

• Getting around: I-29 runs along the west side, with interchanges at 41st Street and farther south.
  • Three school districts: depending on the street, homes can be in Sioux Falls, Tea Area or Harrisburg schools.
  • County line: homes on the far south side are often in Lincoln County, which has a different tax rate than Minnehaha County.
  • HOAs: many newer subdivisions have HOA rules about fences, sheds and parking. Read them before you make an offer.
schools: Depending on the exact address, homes in Southwest Sioux Falls may be in the Sioux Falls, Tea Area, or Harrisburg school districts. Always confirm the school district for a specific address.
